Title: Behaviour first
Prompt: List behaviour changes in this diff. Quote the lines. Do not style-nit. If you are unsure, say so.

Title: Missing test
Prompt: Name a behaviour in the diff that the tests do not cover. Propose the assertion in words, not a whole new framework.

Title: Secret scan
Prompt: Point at anything that looks like a key, password, or connection string. Do not repeat the secret in full if you find one. Say the line number.

Title: Failure path
Prompt: What happens when the input is empty, too large, or the downstream call throws? Answer only from the diff.
Check: You do not invent a catch that is not there.

Title: Name the risk
Prompt: Write one comment: the risk, the line, and the change you want. No introduction.

Title: Leave it
Prompt: List ideas that are not required for this change. Label them 'not for this diff'.
Check: The author can ignore that list.
